data.one_liner: Open source Server-Driven UI (SDUI) framework for cross-platform layouts from JSON
data.what_it_does: DivKit builds native Flutter views from server-sourced JSON data and templates. It enables rapid UI prototyping and lets you ship server-sourced updates to different app versions without releasing new app binaries.
use_when: You want to implement server-driven UI (SDUI) updates in your application
You need to write cross-platform layouts using a JSON schema definition
avoid_when: You need standard purely Dart-defined widget trees without JSON layouts
Full web rendering is heavily required, as the Flutter client has limitations on the web
strengths: Allows updating app UIs via server-side JSON changes
Provides built-in expression calculation and variable storage runtime
Includes support for multiple component types like text, image, container, gallery, and pager
weaknesses: Building DTOs can be expensive and requires careful lifecycle management to avoid frame drops
Web platform support is not fully fledged on the Flutter client
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and initialize DivKitData from JSON or card/templates.
